title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 16: King Ahaz of Judah, his appeal to the king of Assyria and the new altar copied from Damascus.

questions.text: How old was Ahaz when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: What did Ahaz do with his son, according to the abominations of the nations?
questions.explanation: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel and made his son to pass through the fire.

answers.text: He made him pass through the fire
He sent him as a hostage to Assyria
He made him a priest of the high places
He gave him to the king of Syria

questions.text: Which two kings came up to Jerusalem to wage war and besieged Ahaz?
questions.explanation: Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

answers.text: Rezin king of Syria and Pekah king of Israel
Hoshea king of Israel and So king of Egypt

questions.text: Which city did Rezin king of Syria recover to Syria, driving the Jews from it?
questions.explanation: Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria and drove the Jews from Elath.

questions.text: What did Ahaz call himself in his message to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Ahaz sent messengers saying, "I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me."

questions.text: Where did the king of Assyria carry the people of Damascus captive after taking the city?
questions.explanation: The king of Assyria took Damascus, carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

questions.text: Who built an altar according to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus?
questions.explanation: Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus.

questions.text: What did Ahaz say the bronze altar would be used for?
questions.explanation: Ahaz commanded that the offerings be made on the great altar, "but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by."

answers.text: For the burnt offerings of all the people

questions.text: Where did King Ahaz put the sea after taking it down from the bronze oxen?
questions.explanation: He took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it and put it on a pavement of stone.

answers.text: In the treasury of the king
On a cart sent to Assyria

questions.text: Who reigned in Ahaz's place after he died?
questions.explanation: Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried in David's city, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
